edges.reason: Constructor reads msg.sender to establish the initial owner.
Constructor writes owner = msg.sender.
Constructor sets symbol to "GT".
Constructor sets name to "General Token".
Constructor sets decimals to 8.
Constructor assigns the fixed _totalSupply value.
Constructor credits balances[owner] with the entire supply.
Supply computation uses 10**uint(decimals) and a multiplication that can overflow for large decimals.
msg.sender is the untrusted value compared to owner in the onlyOwner require.
onlyOwner authorization gate controls execution of transferOwnership.
onlyOwner authorization gate controls execution of transferAnyERC20Token.
_newOwner parameter is consumed by transferOwnership.
_newOwner is written into the newOwner state variable.
transferOwnership writes the pending newOwner state variable.
acceptOwnership authorizes callers by comparing msg.sender with newOwner.
acceptOwnership reads newOwner for the equality check.
acceptOwnership writes owner, transferring privileged control.
acceptOwnership resets newOwner to address(0).
transfer debits the caller-supplied msg.sender balance.
to parameter flows into transfer as the credit account.
tokens parameter determines the transferred amount in transfer.
transfer updates the balances mapping for both accounts.
transfer calls SafeMath.sub to debit the sender balance.
transfer calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient balance.
transfer returns the success flag.
approve uses msg.sender as the allowance owner key.
spender parameter flows into approve.
tokens parameter becomes the approved allowance in approve.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][spender].
transferFrom uses msg.sender as the spender whose allowance is debited.
from parameter is the debited account in transferFrom.
to parameter is the credited account in transferFrom.
tokens parameter determines the moved amount in transferFrom.
transferFrom updates balances for the from and to accounts.
transferFrom decreases allowed[from][msg.sender].
transferFrom calls SafeMath.sub for balance and allowance debits.
transferFrom calls SafeMath.add to credit the recipient.
transferFrom returns the success flag.
tokenOwner parameter keys the allowance lookup.
spender parameter keys the allowance lookup.
allowance reads the allowed mapping.
allowance returns the remaining allowance value.
tokenOwner parameter keys the balance lookup in balanceOf.
balanceOf reads the balances mapping.
balanceOf returns the account balance.
totalSupply reads the _totalSupply state variable.
totalSupply reads balances[address(0)] as burned supply.
totalSupply calls SafeMath.sub on the total supply.
approveAndCall uses msg.sender as allowance owner and callback argument.
spender parameter becomes both the approved and externally called address.
tokens parameter is approved then forwarded to receiveApproval.
data parameter is forwarded to the external receiveApproval call.
approveAndCall writes allowed[msg.sender][spender] before the external call.
approveAndCall performs an external call into a caller-controlled spender contract.
The untrusted spender receives control during receiveApproval and can re-enter token functions.
approveAndCall returns the success flag after the external call.
tokenAddress parameter selects the external contract to call.
tokens parameter is passed to the external ERC20 transfer call.
transferAnyERC20Token invokes an external call on a caller-supplied token contract.
The arbitrary token contract can execute its own code and re-enter during the external call.
transferAnyERC20Token uses owner as the fixed recipient address.
transferAnyERC20Token returns the external call result as success.
